note: Shared by TAOM.Tests LongDefeatLocationsReaderTests and tools/tests/test_run_long_defeat.py. Expectations are written by hand from phase4-plan.md section 5. `shop` is one shop object of shop.json; classIds are the class ids classes.json holds. Expected sets are objects, slots [slot, item] pairs, engines [kind, price] pairs.
